description: Comment Replies Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

commentId.description: ID of the parent (top-level) comment to fetch replies for — from the comments endpoint. Legacy alias: comment_id.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 50, max 500). Flat 2 credits per call.

url.description: Facebook post URL the comment belongs to. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: facebook_comment_replies
title: Facebook Comment Replies
